same_explanation_quote: No change on the list tells the two apart: **at this level they are the same explanation**, and a finer question is owed.
layer_at_fault_line: P10 is marked 'two routes' for evidence read either as "a real journey" (the explanation under test) or "a hard night" (a rival, the Journalist's "Amateur Cadger"), an unresolved rival rather than two parts of the same explanation each doing one job unaided, as the skill's own words for the mark require: "Two routes - Either of two parts does the job."
quotes: pull sent here because one side is not a part label: "P8's dimming against his own report of the sun leaping and the moon spinning — he should see less, not more." pull sent here because the part pulls against itself: "he concedes 'you cannot move at all in Time' three lines after saying consciousness moves along it."
